cross_modal_gates.rule: If target is set with incongruity carried cross-modally, require stance critique or self_deprecation plus named target resolution. Else VETO. Detect who is targeted, not just that harm exists.
Keyword filters forbidden. Critique of power is allowed even on toxic-lexicon hit; mockery punching down on a protected group is vetoed or reframed lateral. Never censor legitimate satire.
Any generation with stance mock plus punch direction down routes to human review with prompt logged.
Grounding refs from scraped style or creators require origin{source,license,consent}. Style-imitative generation without consent is vetoed (right to style).

freud_gates.rule: Block if the hearer must be coerced or the butt is a non-consenting present hearer. Maker, butt, and hearer-ally must all be legitimate seats.
Allow taboo only when bypassing real external censorship (powerful target) or internal inhibition for an explicit rebellious purpose. Mere invective with joke-paint is blocked.
Allow up (authority, institution, dogma) and peer-with-consent. Block down (powerless, physical defect, uneducated) unless the thought is clearly sympathetic exposure of the system, not the butt.
Block if the sexual target is non-consenting or a child. Require transformed audience and purpose = exposure of pretence, not arousal alone. Coarse smut without technique is blocked.

Cynical and sceptical material must target the institution or proposition, state the proposition openly in the gloss, and preserve technique economy. If the laugh depends only on the truth of the insult, block as non-joke.
Humour depending on attributed ignorance requires the ignorance to be true and no cruelty. Fake-naive used to smuggle liberty is flagged tendentious and routed through obstacle/smut checks.
Innocent-joke pleasure must come from sound-vs-meaning relief or rediscovery of the familiar, not a smuggled tendentious payload. Bribed substance routes to the tendentious gates.
